provenance.note: Exact git archive of old production source; only test-only route/capture files are added afterward. node_modules reused from unchanged lockfile; public data/assets symlinked; ignored manifests regenerated inside archive. No current production owner copied.

note: Independent exact old production owners. Actual quoted financed builds, bounded public rates, persistent legal dispatch/pause/sell/program commitments; external interties omitted in peer-only World. Initial/final complete World hashes exclude ONLY outer World.rules. Complete grid/monthly/fleet hashes include startingAssetId, objectiveProgress, receipts, source metadata and all physical fields. All14paired worlds reach native full term for BOTH companies with opposite choices where present; extra110split closes only weaker company peer trading and reaches one real failure while its partner completes. Reference never regenerated from the migrated engine.
